title: AUTO PARRY + AUTO LEVEL UP + Kill Aura!
features:
MAIN
- Auto Level and 1 Click Level Up
- Auto Quest with a quest picker and a progress readout
- Mob Farm: pick the mob, skip civilians
- World Boss farm: auto boss, boss picker, waits at the spawn when none are up
- Auto Eat Souls for demons, with a soul range
- Auto Pull Levers for the Nightfall Sickles
- Player info: level, exp, wen, race, clan, skill points, kills this session

COMBAT
- Insta Kill with an HP threshold and range
- Kill Aura with a range and a step-into-reach option
- Auto Parry with a parry range and block hold
- Auto Skills: use skills while fighting, pick the skill keys and the delay
- Farm setup: position, distance, height, attack delay
- Auto equip weapon, face target, stop when dead
- TP back on death and retreat below a chosen HP

LOOT
- Auto pick up drops with a range, plus a Pick Up Everything Now button
- Auto collect chests (near or all)

PLAYER
- WalkSpeed and JumpPower with amounts
- Infinite jump, noclip and fly with a fly speed
- No sun damage for demons
- Anti AFK, rejoin and server hop

TRAVEL
- Teleport to any region, NPC, spawn or training spot
- Save your position and return to it

VISUALS
- ESP for mobs, bosses, players, chests, loot drops and quest NPCs with a range slider
- No fog, no atmosphere, no blur, no shadows, no particles and full bright

EXTRAS
- Discord webhook alerts for level ups, boss kills and drops
